question: Anaphase B consists of:

options.opa: Displacement of the chromosomes towards the poles of the spindle.
options.opd: Separation of the poles of the spindle.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Shortening of kinetochore microtubules -> Displacement of the chromosomes towards the poles of the spindle -> Separation of the poles of the spindle -> 95% CHAIN: Shortening of polar microtubules -> Displacement of the chromosomes towards the poles of the spindle -> Separation of the poles of the spindle -> 95%
analysis: During Anaphase B, the polar microtubules lengthen and push the poles of the spindle further apart, contributing to the separation of the poles and elongation of the cell.
